examples.text: Wenn man einen Nebensatz mit den Relativpronomen der, die, das subordiniert, muss man immer auf den Bezug achten, damit sich keine Verständnisschwierigkeiten ergeben.

glosses: in der (beruflichen) Stellung innerhalb einer Hierarchie jemandem unterstellen

examples.text: Der neu gegründete Ausschuss wurde dem Rat subordiniert.

glosses: Placed in a lower class, rank, or position.

examples.text: The several kinds […] and subordinate species of each are easily known.

glosses: Submissive or inferior to, or controlled by authority.

examples.text:
November 9, 1662, Robert South, Of the Creation of Man in the Image of God
It was subordinate, not enslaved, to the understanding.

glosses: dependent on and either modifying or complementing the main clause

examples.text: In the sentence “The barbecue finished before John arrived”, the subordinate clause “before John arrived” specifies the time of the main clause, “The barbecue finished”.

glosses: To embed (a clause) into another clause that is the main one.
To make of lower priority in order of payment in bankruptcy.
To treat (someone) as of less value or importance.
v. 使服从，使居于下位，使依赖
